title: Surveillance and Image-Guided Biopsy of the Esophagus Using an OFDI Capsule
brief_summary: The purpose of this research is to test the feasibility, sensitivity, and specificity of the marking Optical Frequency Domain Imaging (OFDI) capsule for diagnosing Barrett's Esophagus (BE).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients must be undergoing an EGD.
* Patients must be over the age of 18.
* Patients must be able to give informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are on anti-platelet medications or anti-coagulation medications, and NSAIDS at the time of procedure.
* OR patients with a history of hemostasis disorders.
* OR patients with esophageal strictures.
